metadata.title: A Place to Put My Heart | Cinematic Emotional Pop
Before We Called It Love | Cinematic Romantic Pop
If Morning Takes You Away | Cinematic Emotional Pop
metadata.description:
There are moments we already know we cannot keep.

A quiet room after midnight.
A hand resting inside yours.
Someone breathing softly beside you.
The first light waiting behind the curtains.

“If Morning Takes You Away” is a cinematic emotional pop ballad about loving a moment precisely because it cannot last forever.

Warm piano, dreamy analog synths, intimate female vocals, subtle guitar textures, restrained electronic percussion, and cinematic strings create a slow-burning atmosphere of romantic longing and vulnerability.

This isn't a song about asking someone to promise forever.
It's about wanting one more breath before the night becomes morning.

🎧 Best experienced with headphones.

Genre: Emotional Pop Ballad / Cinematic Pop / Electro Pop / Lo-fi Ambient
Mood: Slow • Warm • Intimate • Romantic • Bittersweet • Hopeful
Vocals: Female • Soft • Breathy • Emotionally Raw
Tempo: 74 BPM

metadata.title: The Shape of Your Absence | Cinematic Emotional Pop
metadata.description:
Some people leave our lives without leaving the world they changed behind.

A cup beside the window.
A familiar street beneath November rain.
A song that suddenly sounds different.
A silence that still feels like someone is there.

“The Shape of Your Absence” is a cinematic emotional pop ballad about the quiet traces love leaves behind after someone is gone.

With intimate female vocals, warm piano, atmospheric synths, subtle guitar textures, cinematic strings, and a slow-burning electronic pulse, the song moves from longing toward acceptance.

Sometimes letting go doesn't mean forgetting.
Sometimes it means carrying what was beautiful without carrying the pain.

🎧 Best experienced with headphones.

Genre: Cinematic Emotional Pop / Alternative Pop / Dream Pop
Mood: Romantic • Intimate • Melancholic • Warm • Hopeful
Vocals: Female • Soft • Breathy • Emotional
Tempo: 76 BPM
